column1: void RegisterDebugMenuOption(const FName& category_underscore_menuname, TSubclassOf<UKDebugWidget> menu, UObject* dataObject)
column2:
BlueprintCallable
Call this function to spawn a debug menu that can be accessed using the 'k.debug' console command and pass your menu a data object it can use for initialization. 'category_underscore_menuname' can be parsed to sort the menu into the KDebugDocker (ie. MyCategoryName_MyDebugMenuName).
